attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited submitted its Investor Presentation for November 2026 to the National Stock Exchange. The company migrated its equity shares from the NSE Emerge Platform to the NSE Mainboard on 30 October 2026. Bollywood actor Vicky Kaushal was appointed as the brand ambassador for the STARSHINE brand. The company manufactures Smart LED TVs, fans, and home appliances under the STARSHINE and ARATTON brands. Total blended capacity is 8.5 Lakh units per year with current utilization at nearly 50%. The company targets 80% utilization by FY28. It is expanding into Interactive Flat Panel Displays for the education sector. The company aims for revenue of Rs. 300 Cr. or more by 2028.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Arham Technologies Reports Highest-Ever H1 PAT of ₹9.02 Crore, Up 53% Yoy; Revenue Surges 87% To ₹85.48 Crore".
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited submitted a press release to the National Stock Exchange on November 14, 2026, regarding its financial performance for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 9.02 crore rupees, representing a 53 percent year-on-year increase. Revenue surged 87 percent to 85.48 crore rupees. Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization rose 66 percent to 14.11 crore rupees. The company successfully migrated to the NSE Mainboard on October 30, 2026. It appointed Bollywood actor Vicky Kaushal as brand ambassador and launched a marketing campaign. Arham Technologies targets revenue exceeding 200 crore rupees in the fiscal year 2027. The firm also expanded its product portfolio to include interactive flat panel displays.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Statutory Auditor
Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited intimates that its Statutory Auditors resigned on 14th November, 2026, with immediate effect. The Board will consider the matter in its upcoming meeting to appoint new auditors. The company will inform stakeholders immediately upon appointment. Details required by Annexure A of SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated 11th November, 2024, are enclosed. The resignation is subject to Board approval and subsequent shareholder approval for the new appointment.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited disclosed no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from its preferential issues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 53,56,74,000 through the allotment of equity shares on February 7 and 11, 2026. Funds were utilized for working capital, repayment of borrowings, investment in subsidiary capital expenditure, and general corporate purposes. Additionally, the company raised Rs. 15,24,99,860 through the issue of convertible share warrants on November 7, 2025. Of this amount, Rs. 3,81,24,966 was received, while Rs. 11,43,74,894 remains unutilized pending future tranches. The Audit Committee reviewed and approved these statements on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board also approved the allotment of 4800 equity shares of Rs. 10 each to eligible employees under the Arham Technologies Limited Employee Stock Option Plan, 2024. The exercise price was Rs. 10 per share. Consequently, the paid-up equity share capital increased to Rs. 21,81,68,000 divided into 21816800 equity shares. The company noted the statement of deviation or variation for the period ended 30th September, 2026. The Audit Committee confirmed no deviation in the use of proceeds from the preferential issue of convertible equity share warrants and equity shares. The preferential issue raised Rs. 53,56,74,000. The board meeting was held on 14th November, 2026.
